title: Joyful Aerated German Plant Based Frankfurter Mousse
description: A unique sweet and savory German-inspired spread that uses whipped cream and spices to create a light, cozy texture from plant-based sausages.
instructions: Slice the plant-based frankfurters into very small rounds to prepare them for grinding.
Place the sausage pieces into a large stone mortar and pound them vigorously with the pestle until a smooth paste forms.
In a separate chilled bowl, whip the heavy cream until stiff peaks form.
Fold the softened cream cheese and maple syrup into the pounded sausage paste using a spatula.
Incorporate the nutmeg, smoked paprika, and salt into the mixture until evenly distributed.
Gently fold the whipped cream into the sausage base one third at a time to maintain aeration.
Transfer the mousse into small glass ramekins for a cozy presentation.
Chill the mousse in the refrigerator for at least thirty minutes before serving with toasted rye bread.
